content: Contextual Representation Layer: The contextual representation layer takes as input the sequence of word embeddings, INLINEFORM0 , and outputs an embedding of the contextual representation for each word in the HPI note. The word embeddings are fed into a bi-directional LSTM, which outputs INLINEFORM1 , a concatenation of the hidden states of the two LSTMs for each word.
